title: 🔬 India AI Impact Summit 2026 — Sovereign MANAV Vision, Frontier Commitments & BHASHINI Stack
executiveSummary: PM Narendra Modi unveiled MANAV Vision for AI: Moral systems, Accountable governance, National sovereignty, Accessible & inclusive, Valid & legitimate.
masterKeyFacts: PM Narendra Modi unveiled MANAV Vision for AI: Moral systems, Accountable governance, National sovereignty, Accessible & inclusive, Valid & legitimate.
NPCI offered UPI One World wallet for delegates from 40+ countries at India AI Impact Summit (up to ₹25,000 per load, max ₹50,000/month).
NPCI launched FiMI (Finance Model for India) Small Language Model supporting English, Hindi, Telugu, Bengali on UPI Help Assistant.
NPCI partnered with Nvidia to scale FiMI SLM infrastructure for sovereign payments.
DST funded ₹235 Cr under NM-ICPS + MeitY India AI Mission ₹10,585 Cr for BharatGen sovereign multilingual LLM.
First-ever Global AI Summit in Global South (Feb 16-20) based on People, Planet, Progress. Stanford AI Index 2025 ranks India top 3 in AI vibrancy.
Amitabh Nag (CEO BHASHINI) launched VoicERA in collaboration with EkStep, IIIT Bengaluru, AI4Bharat.
Ashwini Vaishnaw unveiled voluntary Frontier AI commitments adopted by global and Indian tech leaders.
